title: How Indemnification Structure can RUIN your business deal
description:
Indemnification clauses might sound like legal fluff, but they’re one of the most important (and misunderstood) parts of any business purchase agreement. In this video, we break down what indemnification really means, why it matters, and how the terms you agree to can dramatically impact your risk after closing.

We’ll walk through what indemnification clauses typically cover, how indemnification caps work, and why you shouldn’t trust generic online advice when negotiating these terms—especially in deals under $5 million. 

Spoiler: what works in big M&A doesn’t always work in small business acquisitions.

Whether you're buying or selling, this video will help you understand how to protect yourself, what a “reasonable” indemnity cap looks like, and what red flags to watch out for before you sign on the dotted line.
